definition: A speech expressing someone’s thoughts aloud while alone.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: To mend the matter, Hamlet’s aunt had the family failing of indulging in soliloquy, and held forth in a desultory manner, by herself, on every topic that was introduced.
example_sentence: He delivered a soliloquy to the empty kitchen about the bins.
